Collectopus

Collectopus Privacy Policy

Effective date: 1 October 2026
Controller: Kirillov & Co (Maksim Kirillov, individual developer, Ukraine), contact: collectoctopus@gmail.com

1. What Collectopus does

Collectopus lets you photograph real-world objects and turn them into collectible cards.

2. Data we collect

  • Photos you take in the app. Before anything leaves your phone, the app looks for human faces on your device. If a person is the main subject of the photo, nothing is uploaded. Faces that the app detects elsewhere in the photo are pixelated and blurred on your device before upload. A reduced copy of the photo (max 512 px, location metadata removed) is sent to our server and to Google's Gemini API only to recognize the object; we do not store it. We do not store the original photo either. We store only the card picture: the cut-out of the object or, if it can't be cut out, a square crop of the photo with detected faces blurred.
  • Account data: an anonymous account ID; if you choose to sign in with Google — your email and Google account ID; your nickname and avatar card.
  • Approximate location (optional): if you allow it, the app asks only for approximate location, and only when you open City sets. Your phone sends a rough position (rounded to about 1 km) to our server, which looks up the city and country in its own offline list of cities. We store only the city and country; the coordinates are not stored, not logged and not shared with any third party.
  • Gameplay data: your cards, collections, points, streaks, friends, event progress.
  • Purchases: subscription and purchase status via Google Play and RevenueCat. We do not receive your payment card details.
  • Diagnostics and analytics: crash reports (Firebase Crashlytics) and usage events (PostHog). In the EU/UK, analytics run only with your consent.
  • Push token if you allow notifications.

3. How we use data

To provide the game, recognize photos, run leaderboards and events, process subscriptions, send notifications you enabled, fix bugs and improve the app. We do not sell personal data and do not use your photos to train AI models. Google processes the reduced photo under the Gemini API terms for paid services, which do not allow Google to use it to improve its products; Google may keep it for a limited time only to detect abuse, as its terms require.

4. Processors

Supabase (hosting, database, storage — servers in Frankfurt, EU), Google (Gemini API, Firebase, Google Play), PostHog (analytics, EU region), RevenueCat (subscriptions), GitHub (hosting of our website and invite links). They process data on our behalf under their terms. Some of them may process data outside your country, including in the United States; where required, such transfers rely on the providers' standard contractual clauses or equivalent safeguards.

5. Who can see your data

Friends you add can see your nickname, avatar, cards and points. City leaderboards (if enabled) show your nickname and weekly points to other players in your city. Nobody sees your location.

6. Retention

We keep your data while your account exists. Deleting your account removes your profile, cards, images and friendships within 30 days (removal from backups may take up to 30 more days).

7. Your rights

You can access, correct or delete your data: in the app (Settings → Delete account) or at https://playcollectopus.github.io/delete-account/ or by email to collectoctopus@gmail.com. EU/UK users have rights under GDPR, including objection and complaint to a supervisory authority.

8. Children

Collectopus is intended for users aged 13 and older. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13. If you believe a child under 13 has used the app, contact us and we will delete the account.

9. Changes

We will notify you in the app about material changes.

10. Contact
